messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick follow-up from the outage last night — we should schedule an after-action to capture timeline, customer impact, and next steps. Looking for a facilitator and a 45m slot next week. Prefer PST. Who can facilitate and who should be in the room?

incident-bot: Incident page: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-03-14|INC-2026-03-14> — timeline + alerts attached. Suggested participants: oncall, infra, product, CS, SRE.

samir patel: I can join as oncall for context but I have a calendar block Tue/Wed afternoon PT. Not a good week for me to facilitate.

deepti shah: I can facilitate. I ran the runbook during the incident and can lead the timeline review. Available Wed/Thu mornings PT.

ben nguyen: Thanks Deepti. Suggested invite list: Samir (oncall), Kai (infra lead), Ana (product PM), Zoe (CS), Erin (SRE lead), Security rep if there's any data exposure risk. Also maybe a note-taker.

ben nguyen: Proposed slots (PT):
```
- Wed 9:00–9:45
- Wed 11:00–11:45
- Thu 9:00–9:45
- Thu 10:30–11:15
```

calendar-bot: Poll created: "After-action for INC-2026-03-14" — vote here: <https://calendar.redwood/poll/abc123>

zoe lim: Wed 9 works best for CS — we have a customer check-in right after 11. Also want to flag priority customers impacted (I'll bring notes).

erin park: I can take notes if needed. Wed 9 PT works for me. Also please include a short agenda: timeline, root-cause hypotheses, mitigation gaps, action owners.

maria gonzalez: Deepti, do you want to facilitate Wed 9 PT? Can you confirm and I'll send the calendar invite with attendees. Also, who should be required vs optional?

de epti shah: (typo) deepti shah: Yes I can facilitate Wed 9 PT. Required: Samir (oncall), Kai (infra), Ana (product), Zoe (CS), Erin (scribe). Optional: Security, Legal if needed, Eng leads.

samir patel: I moved some things — Wed 9 PT I can make as required.

ben nguyen: I'll add an agenda block to the invite. Quick agenda draft:
```
1) 5m - quick context + impact summary (CS)
2) 20m - timeline walkthrough (oncall + infra)
3) 10m - root-cause discussion + mitigations
4) 10m - action items, owners, and SLAs
```

maria gonzalez: Great. Erin will scribe per earlier? @erin park will you capture action items in the tracker (link below) and assign owners? <https://redwood.internal/tools/action-tracker/INC-2026-03-14>

erin park: Yep I got it. I'll create the postmortem doc after the meeting and link it to the incident page.

calendar-bot: Event created: "After-action: INC-2026-03-14" — Wed Mar 16 09:00 PT, 45m. Attendees invited: deepti shah (facilitator), samir patel (required), kai tran (required), ana rodriguez (required), zoe lim (required), erin park (scribe). <https://calendar.redwood/event/def456>

ben nguyen: Filing initial action item: set TTL on autoscaler from 5m to 2m during traffic surges — owner: Kai. I'll add to tracker.

zoe lim: Note: I'll include a short customer-impact summary and affected account list in the doc before the meeting.

maria gonzalez: Thanks all. Deepti — want me to add any pre-read? I can paste incident timeline + top error logs into the doc.

de epti shah: (deepti shah) pls add the alert graphs and the sequence of automated steps. Pre-read would help speed the meeting.

samir patel: +1 for graphs. Also, I'll bring the oncall console logs.

erin park: I'll post a link to the notes doc in the incident page as soon as I create it.

deepti shah: Confirmed. I'll run the meeting Wed 9 PT. Erin will scribe. Pre-reads: incident timeline (maria), customer impact (Zoe), autoscaler graphs (Samir). See you then. :thumbsup:

maria gonzalez: :thumbsup: I'll send the calendar invite to the required list and mark optional for security/legal. Thanks everyone — closing the loop here.
